title: Statistics research
text:
I am currently a statistics phd student at Boston University working with Luis Carvalho and Mark Friedl.
I help develop bespoke statistical models for a variety of scientific disciplines with a focus on methodologies for efficient inference. I am interested in using rich dependence structures and latent variable dynamics to achieve marginal distribution alignment with data generating processes. Please check out our recent work, where we develop the heterogeneous continuous time Markov chain for noninformative change point processes.
Before joining Boston University, I worked in industry for about 10 years in Biotech, Pharma, Agriculture, and Labor Market industries. During that time, I worked on vaccine antigen development, vaccine effectiveness studies, and clinical trial evaluation. If you are interested in consulting, please reach out to me.
